messages:
Noah: FYI - model-ops dropped calypso-14b-mix artifacts into s3://redwood-models/calypso/14b/mix/2026-03-17

Can we do perf onboarding + quant smoke this week? Need context-sweep, batch profiles, and int8/int4 smoke runs. I'll flag this P1 if quality is within 2% of redwood-13b-v1.

Link to intake: https://internal.redwood/boards/model-intake/12345 :eyes:

Jin: Ack. What are our target SLAs? p50 < 120ms for 16-token streaming, p95 < 400ms? or do we relax for larger ctx?

Noah: Target p50 < 150ms for 32 tok under single-GPU (A100-40G), p95 < 450ms. Throughput goal 60 tokens/sec sustained for batch=1/streaming. If can't hit, note fallback model route.

Sana: I'll run the quality Evals first — can you paste the prompt set? also do we have a labeled eval set for summarization+instruction following?

Noah: Put eval set in gs://evals/calypso/summary_v2.tar.gz. Use the "redwood-summary-suite" (50 prompts). Pass threshold = 0.92 relative to redwood-13b-v1 on ROUGE-L.

Marta: I can run quant smoke. Plan: int8-dl, int8-gptq, int4-gptq. Quick script:

```
./run_quant_smoke.sh --model s3://redwood-models/calypso/14b/mix/ \
  --modes int8-dl,int8-gptq,int4-gptq --batch 1 --ctx 2048 --out results.json
```

Will post perf+quality diffs.

infra-bot: Started ephemeral job r-2983 on a2.4xlarge for initial perf runs. ETA ~20m :rocket:

Eval-bot: Quick eval snapshot: calypso baseline (fp16) vs redwood-13b-v1: ROUGE-L = 0.895 vs 0.912 (0.981 relative). Summary length match good. More detailed per-prompt diffs incoming.

Jin: For perf harness, use:

```
python -m perf_runner --model s3://redwood-models/calypso/14b/mix/ \
  --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --ctx-lengths 128,512,1024,2048 --payload random --iter 500
```

Collect p50/p95/p99 token latency and tokens/sec. Also run KV-cache warmup test for long-chat sequences.

Marta: Starting quant smoke now. I'll target int8-gptq first. Will document perf deltas and run sanity generation checks.

Sana: Starting eval run against summary_v2.

Noah: Plan: if quant int8 drop <3% relative and perf improves >20% -> green for canary. Otherwise hold. Please report by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

Jin: I can take the canary rollout config (route to calypso-14b-mix on 5% traffic) if we get green. Will prepare fallback to redwood-13b-v1 in the route policy.

Marta: Got it. Assigning ticket INF-4521. I'll update with artifacts and results.

Noah: Thanks team — ping me on slack if any blockers.
